academicCalendarEvents.description: Official commencement of Fall semester undergraduate and graduate lectures.

academicCalendarEvents.description: Last day to add, drop, or change course grading options (Pass/Fail) without transcript notation.

academicCalendarEvents.description: Annual multi-industry technology and engineering recruitment fair with over 140 employers.

academicCalendarEvents.description: University holiday. Library open on adjusted holiday weekend hours.

academicCalendarEvents.description: Faculty submit mid-semester performance indicators and academic standing reviews.

academicCalendarEvents.description: Spring 2027 timetable, lecture sections, and faculty assignments published for review.

academicCalendarEvents.description: Thanksgiving campus holiday through Sunday, November 29. Regular classes resume Monday.

academicCalendarEvents.title: Reading & Study Days
academicCalendarEvents.description: Designated quiet study preparation days prior to final examinations. No mandatory classes.
